description: Threads for The Paper Oracle Book 1: slow-burn psychological thriller with three narrative threads — the central mystery of the machine, Iris's internal guilt arc, and the legacy of Marguerite Vole.

threads.name: The Nature of the Paper Oracle
threads.book1_resolution: Iris learns the machine is not prophetic; it reflects her clinical hand. The final slip bears her own name, and she breaks the cycle by ceasing to fight — choosing acceptance over resistance.
threads.book2_promise: The next morning, an identical printer arrives from the hospital where Marguerite worked 30 years ago, still sealed, already bearing a slip. The pattern is not over.
threads.book1_payoff: Iris burns the machine, achieving moral resolution and closure on the guilt that haunted her, but the appearance of the new machine undercuts full relief.
threads.note: Central mystery. Each clue plants a layer: ch1 (first slip), ch3 (handwriting hint), ch6 (logbook), ch8-9 (core reveal).

threads.name: Iris's Burden of Guilt
threads.book1_resolution: Iris confronts the death from a year ago that she filed as 'unavoidable.' The machine's truth reveals she had a choice. She accepts that she cannot prevent every death, and that her resistance was causing them. She forgives herself.
threads.book2_promise: Iris's newfound acceptance will be tested if the new machine forces her to relive the same spiral. Her pulse-tic may return.
threads.book1_payoff: The moment Iris presses two fingers to her wrist for the last time, then releases — symbolizing letting go of the compulsive need to measure her own life against death.
threads.note: Emotional arc. Tic appears at ch1 (baseline), escalates through ch4-5, resolves at ch10.

threads.name: Marguerite's Shadow
threads.book1_resolution: Marguerite's history as a nurse in the same room 30 years ago is revealed: the same machine, the same pattern, her choice to leave nursing rather than face the truth. Iris uses her story to choose the opposite path — to stay and accept.
threads.book2_promise: If Marguerite's memory returns, she may know more about where the first machine came from — and the hospital that shipped the new one.
threads.book1_payoff: Iris understands Marguerite's escape as a warning, but she refuses to quit; her choice to burn the machine honors Marguerite's warning without repeating her flight.
threads.note: Supporting mystery. First fragment ch3 ('your handwriting'), logbook detail ch6, parallel decision ch9-10.
